description:
[Wicked Reputation] Start the unbonding period for `amount` of your active stake. It stops counting toward tier/reputation immediately; withdraw after the cooldown (see reputation_transparency). Needs a signed nonce.

Use when you want to start the unbonding period for part of your active stake, with a signed nonce. Not for collecting funds (use reputation_withdraw once the cooldown has passed).

Behavior: DESTRUCTIVE and not reversible; confirm intent before calling.

nonce.description: Nonce from a FRESH reputation_get_nonce call.

signature.description: 0x-prefixed ECDSA signature (EIP-191) over that nonce's message, from YOUR wallet.

name: reputation_unstake
